nodes.name: Webhook: deal-stage-tag-sync
nodes.notes: Internal, system-to-system endpoint (no session-token auth), meant to be called right after a deal's stage_id is updated (e.g. from the move-opportunity-stage webhook) with the freshly-resolved new stage name. opportunity_id is required even though not explicitly specified, since deal_stage alone doesn't say which deal/contact to act on. contact_id is deliberately NOT required in the payload — it's looked up from the opportunity itself.

parameters.query:
SELECT o.id, o.contact_id, s.pipeline_id
FROM (SELECT $1::int AS oid) dummy
LEFT JOIN opportunities o ON o.id = dummy.oid
LEFT JOIN stages s ON s.id = o.stage_id;

nodes.name: Look Up Opportunity
nodes.notes: Always returns exactly one row (dummy-row LEFT JOIN) even when the opportunity doesn't exist, so the error branch downstream actually fires instead of the whole chain silently going quiet on zero matched rows.

parameters.query:
DELETE FROM taggables tg
USING tags t
WHERE tg.entity_type = 'opportunity'
  AND tg.entity_id = $1
  AND tg.tag_id = t.id
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM stages s_any WHERE s_any.pipeline_id = $2 AND lower(s_any.name) = lower(t.name))
  AND lower(t.name) <> lower($3);

nodes.name: Remove Stray Deal Tag
nodes.notes: Only removes a tag from THIS deal if it matches some other stage name in this deal's own pipeline — never touches non-stage tags (vip, hot lead, etc).

parameters.query:
DELETE FROM taggables tg
USING tags t
WHERE tg.entity_type = 'contact'
  AND tg.entity_id = $1
  AND tg.tag_id = t.id
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM opportunities o JOIN stages s_cur ON s_cur.id = o.stage_id JOIN stages s_any ON s_any.pipeline_id = s_cur.pipeline_id
    WHERE o.contact_id = $1 AND o.is_archived IS NOT TRUE AND lower(s_any.name) = lower(t.name)
  )
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM opportunities o2 JOIN stages s_cur2 ON s_cur2.id = o2.stage_id
    WHERE o2.contact_id = $1 AND o2.is_archived IS NOT TRUE AND lower(s_cur2.name) = lower(t.name)
  );

nodes.name: Remove Stray Contact Tag
nodes.notes: $1 (contactId) is null when the deal has no linked contact — entity_id = NULL matches nothing, so this naturally no-ops. Considers ALL of the contact's open deals (not just this one), so a contact with two open deals in two different stages correctly keeps both stage tags.

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO taggables (tag_id, entity_type, entity_id)
SELECT t.id, 'contact', $2::int
FROM tags t
WHERE lower(t.name) = lower($1) AND $2::int IS NOT NULL
ON CONFLICT (tag_id, entity_type, entity_id) DO NOTHING;
